name: Worrel S. Lee Jr.
role: Data analyst with 7+ years of experience applying R, Power BI, Excel, Power Query, SQL, and DAX to operational, customer, financial, CRM, and program data. heroIntro: I am a Professional MBA candidate in Data Analytics at Houston Christian University with experience using SQL, R, Power BI, DAX, statistical modeling, and data visualization to analyze complex child welfare data.
aboutHeading: Curious by practice. Practical by design.
aboutParagraphs: I am an MBA candidate in Data Analytics at Houston Christian University, where my coursework has focused on practical data analytics, statistical modeling, and data visualization.

Through my internship with the DFPS Analytical Projects Team, I have gained experience using R, Power BI, and statistical methods to analyze complex child welfare data. My interests center on using data to uncover meaningful patterns and translate them into practical insights that support better decision-making.

My professional research presentation, From Acuity to Placement Stability: How Initial CANS Needs Relate to Placement Disruption, examines whether needs identified through the initial CANS are associated with later placement disruption. Public materials on this site are limited to approved portfolio language and do not include presentation slides, visuals, underlying data, or non-public materials.
